_note: How each kind of weapon is held (owner A). Written by Claude after the play-test: weapons looked too big and were all held the same way. Lengths are in art pixels of the character (a hero is about 20 pixels tall). grip = where the hand holds the weapon, as a share of its length from the bottom end (0.1 = near the handle end, 0.6 = a bit above the middle). hand = [how far in front of the body, how far above the feet]. hold_angle = degrees the weapon leans while held (minus = the top leans forward); raised_angle = while a bow or staff attacks. max_length = the weapon is drawn smaller (by a whole number, so pixels stay square) until it is at most about this long. A weapon listed under weapons changes only the values it names; big: true lets a bow use big_max_length.
